title: 低雜訊偵測器讀出
summary: 以矽微條與 HPGe 前端為例，從 Ramo 定理與電荷靈敏積分出發，推導 ENC 的串聯、並聯與 1/f 項如何隨電容與整形時間變化，再把脈衝校正、能量解析度分解、ASIC 數位化與門檻佔用率整合成可交接的讀出系統驗證紀錄。
summaryEn: Using silicon-strip and HPGe front ends as examples, start from Ramo's theorem and charge-sensitive integration, derive how the series, parallel and 1/f terms of ENC scale with capacitance and shaping time, then integrate pulse calibration, resolution decomposition, ASIC digitisation and threshold occupancy into a transferable readout-validation record.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 雜訊預算練習：矽微條感測器 C_d = 20 pF，加上前端輸入電容 3 pF 與走線 2 pF，總 C = 25 pF；輸入電晶體 e_n = 1 nV/√Hz，漏電流 1 nA，回授電阻 100 MΩ，CR-RC 整形 τ = 1 µs。並聯雜訊電流 i_n = √(2qI + 4kT/R_f) = √(3.2×10⁻²⁸ + 1.66×10⁻²⁸) = 2.2×10⁻¹⁴ A/√Hz。串聯項 ENC_s = √(0.92×(10⁻⁹)²×(25×10⁻¹²)²/10⁻⁶)/q = 150 e⁻，並聯項 ENC_p = √(0.92×(2.2×10⁻¹⁴)²×10⁻⁶)/q = 132 e⁻，合計 200 e⁻。MIP 訊號 24,000 e⁻，訊噪比 120。若感測器受輻照後漏電流升到 100 nA，i_n 升到 1.8×10⁻¹³ A/√Hz，ENC_p = 1070 e⁻，總 ENC ≈ 1080 e⁻，訊噪比降到 22；把 τ 縮短到 0.2 µs 後 ENC_s = 335、ENC_p = 480，總 ENC ≈ 585 e⁻，訊噪比回到 41。數值為教學假設，不代表任何實際晶片的規格。
workedExample.textEn: Noise-budget exercise: a silicon strip sensor with C_d = 20 pF plus 3 pF of front-end input capacitance and 2 pF of trace gives C = 25 pF; the input transistor has e_n = 1 nV/√Hz, leakage is 1 nA, the feedback resistor 100 MΩ, with CR-RC shaping at τ = 1 µs. Parallel noise current i_n = √(2qI + 4kT/R_f) = √(3.2×10⁻²⁸ + 1.66×10⁻²⁸) = 2.2×10⁻¹⁴ A/√Hz. Series term ENC_s = √(0.92×(10⁻⁹)²×(25×10⁻¹²)²/10⁻⁶)/q = 150 e⁻, parallel term ENC_p = √(0.92×(2.2×10⁻¹⁴)²×10⁻⁶)/q = 132 e⁻, total 200 e⁻. The MIP signal of 24,000 e⁻ gives a signal-to-noise ratio of 120. If irradiation raises leakage to 100 nA, i_n becomes 1.8×10⁻¹³ A/√Hz, ENC_p = 1070 e⁻, total ENC ≈ 1080 e⁻ and the ratio drops to 22; shortening τ to 0.2 µs gives ENC_s = 335 and ENC_p = 480, total ≈ 585 e⁻, restoring the ratio to 41. Values are teaching assumptions, not any real chip's specification.

stages.title: 系統邊界與物理原理
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「訊號電荷、Ramo 定理與電荷靈敏放大」與「等效雜訊電荷：串聯、並聯與 1/f 項」：先建立機制與定量模型，再設計驗證並診斷失效。

steps.title: 訊號電荷、Ramo 定理與電荷靈敏放大：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Signal charge, Ramo's theorem and charge-sensitive amplification: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「感測器電荷與回授電容」如何決定低雜訊偵測器讀出的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Sensor charge and feedback capacitor” determines the key performance of “Low-noise detector readout”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 偵測器送出的不是「到達電極的電荷」而是感應電流：依 Shockley–Ramo 定理，以速度 v 運動的電荷 q 在電極上感應的電流為 i = q·v·E_w，E_w 是把該電極設為 1 V、其餘接地時的加權場；電流對時間積分才等於訊號電荷。矽中一個最小游離粒子每微米約產生 80 個電子電洞對，300 µm 厚的感測器給出約 2.4×10⁴ 個電子，只有 3.8 fC。電荷靈敏前置放大器把這些電荷積分到回授電容 C_f 上，輸出 Q/C_f 與偵測器電容無關，前提是開迴路增益夠大。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「感測器電荷與回授電容」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A detector does not deliver charge arriving at the electrode but an induced current: by the Shockley–Ramo theorem a charge q moving with velocity v induces i = q·v·E_w on an electrode, where E_w is the weighting field obtained by setting that electrode to 1 V and all others to ground; only the time integral of this current equals the signal charge. A minimum-ionising particle creates about 80 electron–hole pairs per micrometre of silicon, so a 300 µm sensor yields about 2.4×10⁴ electrons, only 3.8 fC. A charge-sensitive preamplifier integrates this charge onto its feedback capacitor C_f, giving an output Q/C_f that is independent of detector capacitance provided the open-loop gain is large enough. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Sensor charge and feedback capacitor”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：Q = 24,000 e × 1.6×10⁻¹⁹ C = 3.84 fC；C_f = 100 fF 時 V_out = Q/C_f = 38.4 mV（10 mV/fC）；輸入端看到的等效電容為 (A+1)·C_f，要讓偵測器電容 C_d = 20 pF 的電荷幾乎全部流進回授電容需 A·C_f ≫ C_d：取 A = 10⁴，(A+1)·C_f = 1 nF ≫ 20 pF，電荷收集損失僅 C_d/((A+1)·C_f) ≈ 2%。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Q = 24,000 e × 1.6×10⁻¹⁹ C = 3.84 fC; with C_f = 100 fF, V_out = Q/C_f = 38.4 mV (10 mV/fC); the capacitance seen at the input is (A+1)·C_f, and to pull nearly all the charge of a C_d = 20 pF detector into the feedback capacitor one needs A·C_f ≫ C_d: with A = 10⁴, (A+1)·C_f = 1 nF ≫ 20 pF and the charge-collection loss is only C_d/((A+1)·C_f) ≈ 2%.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「電荷靈敏放大器的增益由偵測器電容決定。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "The gain of a charge-sensitive amplifier is set by the detector capacitance." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「感測器電荷與回授電容」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Sensor charge and feedback capacitor”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

steps.title: 訊號電荷、Ramo 定理與電荷靈敏放大：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Signal charge, Ramo's theorem and charge-sensitive amplification: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「感測器電荷與回授電容」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Sensor charge and feedback capacitor” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：Q = 24,000 e × 1.6×10⁻¹⁹ C = 3.84 fC；C_f = 100 fF 時 V_out = Q/C_f = 38.4 mV（10 mV/fC）；輸入端看到的等效電容為 (A+1)·C_f，要讓偵測器電容 C_d = 20 pF 的電荷幾乎全部流進回授電容需 A·C_f ≫ C_d：取 A = 10⁴，(A+1)·C_f = 1 nF ≫ 20 pF，電荷收集損失僅 C_d/((A+1)·C_f) ≈ 2%。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Q = 24,000 e × 1.6×10⁻¹⁹ C = 3.84 fC; with C_f = 100 fF, V_out = Q/C_f = 38.4 mV (10 mV/fC); the capacitance seen at the input is (A+1)·C_f, and to pull nearly all the charge of a C_d = 20 pF detector into the feedback capacitor one needs A·C_f ≫ C_d: with A = 10⁴, (A+1)·C_f = 1 nF ≫ 20 pF and the charge-collection loss is only C_d/((A+1)·C_f) ≈ 2%. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以已知電容 C_inj 注入階躍電壓產生校正電荷 Q = C_inj·ΔV，量輸出階躍高度得到 mV/fC 增益；在輸入端並聯 5–50 pF 的測試電容確認增益不隨 C_d 改變；再用示波器檢查上升時間是否對應電荷收集時間，並與 Ramo 定理算出的感應電流波形比較。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Inject a voltage step through a known capacitor C_inj to make a calibration charge Q = C_inj·ΔV and read the output step to get the gain in mV/fC; add 5–50 pF of test capacitance across the input to confirm the gain does not change with C_d; then check on an oscilloscope that the rise time matches the charge-collection time and compare with the induced-current waveform predicted by Ramo's theorem.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

steps.title: 訊號電荷、Ramo 定理與電荷靈敏放大：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Signal charge, Ramo's theorem and charge-sensitive amplification: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「感測器電荷與回授電容」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Sensor charge and feedback capacitor” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 以已知電容 C_inj 注入階躍電壓產生校正電荷 Q = C_inj·ΔV，量輸出階躍高度得到 mV/fC 增益；在輸入端並聯 5–50 pF 的測試電容確認增益不隨 C_d 改變；再用示波器檢查上升時間是否對應電荷收集時間，並與 Ramo 定理算出的感應電流波形比較。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Inject a voltage step through a known capacitor C_inj to make a calibration charge Q = C_inj·ΔV and read the output step to get the gain in mV/fC; add 5–50 pF of test capacitance across the input to confirm the gain does not change with C_d; then check on an oscilloscope that the rise time matches the charge-collection time and compare with the induced-current waveform predicted by Ramo's theorem. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：開迴路增益不足或回授電容選得太大時，增益開始隨偵測器電容變化，電容不同的通道增益不一致，整個系統的能量刻度跟著溫度與偏壓漂移。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: With insufficient open-loop gain or an oversized feedback capacitor the gain starts to depend on detector capacitance, channels with different capacitance disagree, and the system energy scale drifts with temperature and bias.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.

steps.instruction: 開迴路增益不足或回授電容選得太大時，增益開始隨偵測器電容變化，電容不同的通道增益不一致，整個系統的能量刻度跟著溫度與偏壓漂移。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: With insufficient open-loop gain or an oversized feedback capacitor the gain starts to depend on detector capacitance, channels with different capacitance disagree, and the system energy scale drifts with temperature and bias. steps.title: 等效雜訊電荷：串聯、並聯與 1/f 項：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Equivalent noise charge: series, parallel and 1/f terms: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「ENC 公式與整形時間」如何決定低雜訊偵測器讀出的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “ENC relation and shaping time” determines the key performance of “Low-noise detector readout”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 把所有雜訊折算到輸入端，以等效雜訊電荷 ENC 表示：串聯（電壓）雜訊來自輸入電晶體的通道熱雜訊 e_n² = 4kT·Γ/g_m，經輸入總電容 C 轉成電荷，隨整形時間 τ 縮短而增大；並聯（電流）雜訊來自漏電流的散粒雜訊 2qI 與回授電阻的熱雜訊 4kT/R_f，隨 τ 加長而增大；1/f 雜訊與 τ 無關，只隨 C² 成長。ENC² = F_v·e_n²·C²/τ + F_i·i_n²·τ + F_vf·A_f·C²，F 為整形器的形狀因子，CR-RC 整形的 F_v = F_i ≈ 0.92。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「ENC 公式與整形時間」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: All noise is referred to the input as an equivalent noise charge (ENC): series (voltage) noise comes from the channel thermal noise of the input transistor, e_n² = 4kT·Γ/g_m, converted to charge through the total input capacitance C and growing as the shaping time τ shortens; parallel (current) noise comes from leakage-current shot noise 2qI and feedback-resistor thermal noise 4kT/R_f and grows as τ lengthens; 1/f noise is independent of τ and scales only with C². ENC² = F_v·e_n²·C²/τ + F_i·i_n²·τ + F_vf·A_f·C², where the F factors depend on the shaper, with F_v = F_i ≈ 0.92 for CR-RC shaping. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “ENC relation and shaping time”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設：總輸入電容 C = 25 pF、輸入電晶體雜訊 e_n = 1 nV/√Hz、漏電流 I_leak = 1 nA、回授電阻 R_f = 100 MΩ、整形時間 τ = 1 µs、CR-RC 整形：並聯雜訊電流密度 i_n² = 2qI + 4kT/R_f = 3.2×10⁻²⁸ + 1.66×10⁻²⁸ = 4.9×10⁻²⁸ A²/Hz；串聯項 ENC_s² = 0.92×10⁻¹⁸×(25×10⁻¹²)²/10⁻⁶ = 5.75×10⁻³⁴ C² → 150 e⁻；並聯項 ENC_p² = 0.92×4.9×10⁻²⁸×10⁻⁶ = 4.5×10⁻³⁴ C² → 132 e⁻；合計 √(150² + 132²) ≈ 200 e⁻ rms（忽略 1/f 項）。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Take C = 25 pF, e_n = 1 nV/√Hz, I_leak = 1 nA, R_f = 100 MΩ, τ = 1 µs and CR-RC shaping: i_n² = 2qI + 4kT/R_f = 3.2×10⁻²⁸ + 1.66×10⁻²⁸ = 4.9×10⁻²⁸ A²/Hz; series term ENC_s² = 0.92×10⁻¹⁸×(25×10⁻¹²)²/10⁻⁶ = 5.75×10⁻³⁴ C² → 150 e⁻; parallel term ENC_p² = 0.92×4.9×10⁻²⁸×10⁻⁶ = 4.5×10⁻³⁴ C² → 132 e⁻; total √(150² + 132²) ≈ 200 e⁻ rms (ignoring the 1/f term).
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「整形時間越長，雜訊一定越低。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Longer shaping time always means lower noise." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「ENC 公式與整形時間」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “ENC relation and shaping time”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

steps.title: 等效雜訊電荷：串聯、並聯與 1/f 項：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Equivalent noise charge: series, parallel and 1/f terms: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「ENC 公式與整形時間」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “ENC relation and shaping time” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設：總輸入電容 C = 25 pF、輸入電晶體雜訊 e_n = 1 nV/√Hz、漏電流 I_leak = 1 nA、回授電阻 R_f = 100 MΩ、整形時間 τ = 1 µs、CR-RC 整形：並聯雜訊電流密度 i_n² = 2qI + 4kT/R_f = 3.2×10⁻²⁸ + 1.66×10⁻²⁸ = 4.9×10⁻²⁸ A²/Hz；串聯項 ENC_s² = 0.92×10⁻¹⁸×(25×10⁻¹²)²/10⁻⁶ = 5.75×10⁻³⁴ C² → 150 e⁻；並聯項 ENC_p² = 0.92×4.9×10⁻²⁸×10⁻⁶ = 4.5×10⁻³⁴ C² → 132 e⁻；合計 √(150² + 132²) ≈ 200 e⁻ rms（忽略 1/f 項）。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Take C = 25 pF, e_n = 1 nV/√Hz, I_leak = 1 nA, R_f = 100 MΩ, τ = 1 µs and CR-RC shaping: i_n² = 2qI + 4kT/R_f = 3.2×10⁻²⁸ + 1.66×10⁻²⁸ = 4.9×10⁻²⁸ A²/Hz; series term ENC_s² = 0.92×10⁻¹⁸×(25×10⁻¹²)²/10⁻⁶ = 5.75×10⁻³⁴ C² → 150 e⁻; parallel term ENC_p² = 0.92×4.9×10⁻²⁸×10⁻⁶ = 4.5×10⁻³⁴ C² → 132 e⁻; total √(150² + 132²) ≈ 200 e⁻ rms (ignoring the 1/f term). Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：用脈衝產生器注入固定電荷，把輸出峰值分佈的標準差換算成 ENC；掃描整形時間 0.25–8 µs 畫出 ENC 對 τ 的曲線，短 τ 端斜率 −1/2 對應串聯項、長 τ 端斜率 +1/2 對應並聯項、中間平坦段代表 1/f 項；再固定 τ、改變輸入電容量出斜率 dENC/dC。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Inject a fixed charge from a pulser and convert the standard deviation of the output peak distribution into ENC; scan shaping time from 0.25 to 8 µs and plot ENC versus τ, where the −1/2 slope at short τ is the series term, the +1/2 slope at long τ the parallel term and a flat region the 1/f term; then fix τ and vary input capacitance to measure the slope dENC/dC.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

steps.objective: 說明「輸入電晶體與回授網路」如何決定低雜訊偵測器讀出的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Input transistor and feedback network” determines the key performance of “Low-noise detector readout”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 串聯雜訊由輸入電晶體的跨導與閘極電容決定：JFET 在室溫到 120 K 之間 g_m 高、1/f 雜訊低，是 HPGe 與 Si(Li) 光譜儀的傳統選擇；深次微米 CMOS 讓每通道功耗降到毫瓦等級，適合數十萬通道的 ASIC。閘極電容會加進總電容 C，若 g_m ∝ √C_gs（強反轉、固定電流密度），最佳條件是 C_gs ≈ C_d，這就是電容匹配法則。回授元件必須極低漏電與低介電吸收：C_f 用 NP0/C0G 或晶片上的金屬電容，放電路徑用 GΩ 級電阻、脈衝重置或連續的電晶體回授。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「輸入電晶體與回授網路」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Series noise is set by the transconductance and gate capacitance of the input transistor: a JFET between room temperature and 120 K offers high g_m and low 1/f noise and remains the traditional choice for HPGe and Si(Li) spectrometers, while deep-submicron CMOS brings per-channel power down to milliwatts for ASICs with hundreds of thousands of channels. The gate capacitance adds to the total C, and if g_m ∝ √C_gs (strong inversion at fixed current density) the optimum is C_gs ≈ C_d, the capacitive-matching rule. Feedback elements must have extremely low leakage and dielectric absorption: C_f is an NP0/C0G or on-chip metal capacitor, and discharge uses a GΩ-class resistor, pulsed reset or continuous transistor feedback. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Input transistor and feedback network”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：輸入電晶體的電壓雜訊密度 e_n = √(4kT·Γ/g_m)：室溫 T = 300 K、Γ = 0.7、跨導 g_m = 20 mS 時 4kT = 1.66×10⁻²⁰ J，e_n = √(1.66×10⁻²⁰×0.7/0.02) = √(5.8×10⁻¹⁹) ≈ 0.76 nV/√Hz；同一顆 JFET 冷卻到 120 K，4kT 降為 6.6×10⁻²¹ J，e_n ≈ 0.48 nV/√Hz，串聯雜訊電荷按比例降低 37%；回授電阻從 100 MΩ 提高到 1 GΩ，其熱雜訊電流由 1.29×10⁻¹⁴ 降到 0.41×10⁻¹⁴ A/√Hz。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: e_n = √(4kT·Γ/g_m): at T = 300 K, Γ = 0.7 and g_m = 20 mS, 4kT = 1.66×10⁻²⁰ J and e_n = √(1.66×10⁻²⁰×0.7/0.02) = √(5.8×10⁻¹⁹) ≈ 0.76 nV/√Hz; cooling the same JFET to 120 K lowers 4kT to 6.6×10⁻²¹ J and e_n to ≈ 0.48 nV/√Hz, cutting the series noise charge by 37%; raising the feedback resistor from 100 MΩ to 1 GΩ reduces its thermal noise current from 1.29×10⁻¹⁴ to 0.41×10⁻¹⁴ A/√Hz.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「輸入電晶體做得越大、閘極電容越大，雜訊就越低。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。

steps.instruction: 回授電阻若用一般厚膜電阻，其過剩雜訊與電壓係數讓並聯雜訊比 4kT/R 大數倍，而且高阻值下的寄生電容使放電時間常數隨溫度漂移，基線在高計數率時堆積。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。

steps.title: 前端介面、雜散電容與接地設計：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Front-end interface, stray capacitance and grounding: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「偏壓網路、接地與佈局」如何決定低雜訊偵測器讀出的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Bias network, grounding and layout” determines the key performance of “Low-noise detector readout”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 從偵測器到前置放大器輸入之間的每一 pF 雜散電容都直接加進串聯雜訊：打線、保護二極體、偏壓耦合電容與 PCB 走線都要計入。偏壓透過大電阻與 AC 耦合電容送到感測器，耦合電容必須承受全偏壓且漏電極低；接地採單點或星形，讓偵測器回流電流與數位地分開，否則切換式電源與時脈的 100 kHz–10 MHz 干擾正好落在整形器通帶內。低雜訊讀出有一半是機械與佈局工程。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「偏壓網路、接地與佈局」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Every picofarad of stray capacitance between detector and preamplifier input adds directly to series noise: bond wires, protection diodes, bias-coupling capacitors and PCB traces all count. Half of low-noise readout is mechanical and layout engineering. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Bias network, grounding and layout”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: At τ = 1 µs the series term is 150 e⁻ at 25 pF, a slope dENC_s/dC = 6 e⁻/pF; an extra 3 pF of trace capacitance raises the series term to 168 e⁻ and the total ENC from 200 to √(168² + 132²) ≈ 214 e⁻ (+7%); a bias resistor R_b = 10 MΩ has a thermal noise current √(4kT/R_b) = 4.1×10⁻¹⁴ A/√Hz, larger than the 1.8×10⁻¹⁴ shot noise of 1 nA leakage, and moving to 100 MΩ brings it down to 1.3×10⁻¹⁴.

steps.title: 校正脈衝、能量刻度與解析度分解：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Calibration pulses, energy scale and resolution decomposition: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「脈衝注入與 HPGe 能譜」如何決定低雜訊偵測器讀出的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Pulse injection and HPGe spectrum” determines the key performance of “Low-noise detector readout”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 校正從精密脈衝注入開始：階躍電壓 ΔV 經注入電容 C_inj 產生 Q = C_inj·ΔV，掃描 ΔV 得到增益、線性度與動態範圍；脈衝器峰的寬度只含電子雜訊，是分離雜訊來源的工具。對能譜儀而言，實測峰寬是三項的平方和：電子雜訊 FWHM_e = 2.355·ENC·ε（ε 為每對電子電洞對的能量）、統計項 FWHM_F = 2.355·√(F·E·ε)（F 為 Fano 因子）、以及電荷收集不完整項；把三項分開，才知道該改前端、偵測器還是整形。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「脈衝注入與 HPGe 能譜」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Calibration starts with precise pulse injection: a voltage step ΔV through an injection capacitor C_inj creates Q = C_inj·ΔV, and sweeping ΔV yields gain, linearity and dynamic range; the pulser peak width contains only electronic noise, which makes it the tool for separating noise sources. For a spectrometer the measured peak width is the quadrature sum of three terms: electronic noise FWHM_e = 2.355·ENC·ε (ε the energy per electron–hole pair), the statistical term FWHM_F = 2.355·√(F·E·ε) (F the Fano factor), and incomplete charge collection; only when the three are separated do you know whether to improve the front end, the detector or the shaping. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Pulse injection and HPGe spectrum”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：以 HPGe 偵測器量 ⁶⁰Co 的 1332 keV 譜線為例：每對電子電洞對能量 ε = 2.96 eV、Fano 因子 F = 0.11，統計項 FWHM_F = 2.355×√(0.11×1.332×10⁶×2.96) eV = 2.355×659 eV ≈ 1.55 keV；ENC = 100 e⁻ 的電子雜訊項 FWHM_e = 2.355×100×2.96 eV ≈ 0.70 keV；電荷收集項取 0.50 keV，總 FWHM = √(1.55² + 0.70² + 0.50²) ≈ 1.77 keV。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: HPGe at 1332 keV: ε = 2.96 eV, F = 0.11, FWHM_F = 2.355×√(0.11×1.332×10⁶×2.96) eV = 2.355×659 eV ≈ 1.55 keV; an ENC of 100 e⁻ gives FWHM_e = 2.355×100×2.96 eV ≈ 0.70 keV; taking 0.50 keV for charge collection, total FWHM = √(1.55² + 0.70² + 0.50²) ≈ 1.77 keV.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「能譜峰寬完全由前置放大器的雜訊決定。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Spectral peak width is set entirely by preamplifier noise." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「脈衝注入與 HPGe 能譜」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。

steps.observation: 如何核對：在同一次量測中同時取 ⁶⁰Co 的 1332 keV 峰與脈衝器峰：脈衝器峰寬給 FWHM_e，由 F 與 ε 算 FWHM_F，殘差歸給電荷收集；再用多個 γ 能量擬合峰寬平方對能量的線性關係 FWHM² = a + b·E，截距 a 應等於 FWHM_e²，斜率 b 應接近 2.355²·F·ε。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Acquire the ⁶⁰Co 1332 keV peak and the pulser peak in the same run: the pulser width gives FWHM_e, F and ε give FWHM_F, and the residual is assigned to charge collection; then fit the squared width against energy for several γ lines, FWHM² = a + b·E, where the intercept a should equal FWHM_e² and the slope b should approach 2.355²·F·ε.

steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「脈衝注入與 HPGe 能譜」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。

steps.instruction: 在同一次量測中同時取 ⁶⁰Co 的 1332 keV 峰與脈衝器峰：脈衝器峰寬給 FWHM_e，由 F 與 ε 算 FWHM_F，殘差歸給電荷收集；再用多個 γ 能量擬合峰寬平方對能量的線性關係 FWHM² = a + b·E，截距 a 應等於 FWHM_e²，斜率 b 應接近 2.355²·F·ε。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。

steps.instruction: 注入電容的實際值與標稱差 5% 時，所有通道的能量刻度一起偏 5%，而且線性度檢查看不出來；脈衝器上升時間若比電荷收集慢，校正出的增益會低估彈道虧損。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。

steps.title: 最佳整形時間、堆積與雜訊預算：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Optimum shaping time, pile-up and the noise budget: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「ENC–τ 曲線與雜訊轉角」如何決定低雜訊偵測器讀出的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “ENC–τ curve and noise corner” determines the key performance of “Low-noise detector readout”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 串聯項與並聯項相等之處就是雜訊轉角，對應最佳整形時間 τ_opt = (C·e_n/i_n)·√(F_v/F_i)；轉角隨電容、漏電流與溫度移動，所以最佳 τ 不是固定值。整形時間同時決定計數率能力：一個脈衝佔用約數倍 τ，計數率 n 下的堆積機率約為 1 − exp(−n·T_p)，因此高計數率應用常犧牲 ENC 選較短的 τ，或改用梯形數位整形把雜訊濾波與彈道虧損分開處理。完整的雜訊預算要把串聯、並聯、1/f、量化與干擾各項列表後平方相加。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「ENC–τ 曲線與雜訊轉角」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The noise corner is where the series and parallel terms are equal, corresponding to the optimum shaping time τ_opt = (C·e_n/i_n)·√(F_v/F_i); the corner moves with capacitance, leakage and temperature, so the optimum τ is not a fixed number. Shaping time also sets rate capability: a pulse occupies several τ, and at count rate n the pile-up probability is about 1 − exp(−n·T_p), so high-rate applications often sacrifice ENC for shorter τ or use trapezoidal digital shaping that separates noise filtering from ballistic deficit. A complete noise budget tabulates series, parallel, 1/f, quantisation and interference terms and adds them in quadrature. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “ENC–τ curve and noise corner”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

knowledge.title: 最佳整形時間、堆積與雜訊預算
knowledge.titleEn: Optimum shaping time, pile-up and the noise budget
knowledge.text: 串聯項與並聯項相等之處就是雜訊轉角，對應最佳整形時間 τ_opt = (C·e_n/i_n)·√(F_v/F_i)；轉角隨電容、漏電流與溫度移動，所以最佳 τ 不是固定值。整形時間同時決定計數率能力：一個脈衝佔用約數倍 τ，計數率 n 下的堆積機率約為 1 − exp(−n·T_p)，因此高計數率應用常犧牲 ENC 選較短的 τ，或改用梯形數位整形把雜訊濾波與彈道虧損分開處理。
knowledge.textEn: The noise corner is where the series and parallel terms are equal, corresponding to the optimum shaping time τ_opt = (C·e_n/i_n)·√(F_v/F_i); the corner moves with capacitance, leakage and temperature, so the optimum τ is not a fixed number. Shaping time also sets rate capability: a pulse occupies several τ, and at count rate n the pile-up probability is about 1 − exp(−n·T_p), so high-rate applications often sacrifice ENC for shorter τ or use trapezoidal digital shaping that separates noise filtering from ballistic deficit.

stages.title: 系統整合、驗證與工程交接
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「整合：ASIC 讀出、數位化與動態範圍」與「系統驗證、門檻設定與工程交接」：先建立機制與定量模型，再設計驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Integration: ASIC readout, digitisation and dynamic range" and "System validation, threshold setting and engineering handoff": build the mechanism and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 整合：ASIC 讀出、數位化與動態範圍：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Integration: ASIC readout, digitisation and dynamic range: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「ADC、數位濾波與資料鏈」如何決定低雜訊偵測器讀出的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “ADC, digital filtering and data links” determines the key performance of “Low-noise detector readout”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 現代系統把前置放大、整形、ADC 與序列化放進同一顆 ASIC：ALICE TPC 的 524,160 個墊片各有一條 SAMPA 通道，CAEN FERS-5200 一類的讀出平台則把 Citiroc 或 picoTDC 前端做成 64–128 通道的卡，經光纖集中。數位化後常以梯形濾波取代類比整形，並做基線追蹤與共模扣除；ADC 的量化雜訊 LSB/√12 必須遠小於類比 ENC，動態範圍則由滿刻度電荷與 ENC 之比決定，通常以位元數換取功耗。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「ADC、數位濾波與資料鏈」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Modern systems put preamplifier, shaper, ADC and serialiser on one ASIC: each of the 524,160 pads of the ALICE TPC has its own SAMPA channel, and readout platforms such as CAEN FERS-5200 integrate Citiroc or picoTDC front ends on 64–128-channel cards concentrated over optical links. After digitisation a trapezoidal filter often replaces analogue shaping, with baseline tracking and common-mode subtraction; the ADC quantisation noise LSB/√12 must stay well below the analogue ENC, and the dynamic range is the ratio of full-scale charge to ENC, usually traded against power through the bit count. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “ADC, digital filtering and data links”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：設前端增益 50 mV/fC、10 位元 ADC、滿刻度 1 V：最小量化單位 LSB = 0.98 mV = 0.0195 fC ≈ 122 e⁻，量化雜訊 122/√12 ≈ 35 e⁻，與 200 e⁻ 的類比 ENC 平方相加只增加 1.5%；滿刻度電荷 1 V ÷ 50 mV/fC = 20 fC = 1.25×10⁵ e⁻ ≈ 5.2 個 MIP，動態範圍 1.25×10⁵/200 ≈ 625；每通道功耗 1 mW 時 10⁶ 個通道共耗 1 kW。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Gain 50 mV/fC, 10-bit ADC, 1 V full scale: LSB = 0.98 mV = 0.0195 fC ≈ 122 e⁻, quantisation noise 122/√12 ≈ 35 e⁻, which adds only 1.5% in quadrature to a 200 e⁻ analogue ENC; full-scale charge 1 V ÷ 50 mV/fC = 20 fC = 1.25×10⁵ e⁻ ≈ 5.2 MIPs, a dynamic range of 1.25×10⁵/200 ≈ 625; at 1 mW per channel, 10⁶ channels dissipate 1 kW.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「只要 ADC 位元數夠多，類比前端的雜訊就不重要。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "With enough ADC bits, analogue front-end noise no longer matters." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「ADC、數位濾波與資料鏈」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “ADC, digital filtering and data links”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

steps.title: 整合：ASIC 讀出、數位化與動態範圍：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Integration: ASIC readout, digitisation and dynamic range: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「ADC、數位濾波與資料鏈」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “ADC, digital filtering and data links” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：設前端增益 50 mV/fC、10 位元 ADC、滿刻度 1 V：最小量化單位 LSB = 0.98 mV = 0.0195 fC ≈ 122 e⁻，量化雜訊 122/√12 ≈ 35 e⁻，與 200 e⁻ 的類比 ENC 平方相加只增加 1.5%；滿刻度電荷 1 V ÷ 50 mV/fC = 20 fC = 1.25×10⁵ e⁻ ≈ 5.2 個 MIP，動態範圍 1.25×10⁵/200 ≈ 625；每通道功耗 1 mW 時 10⁶ 個通道共耗 1 kW。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Gain 50 mV/fC, 10-bit ADC, 1 V full scale: LSB = 0.98 mV = 0.0195 fC ≈ 122 e⁻, quantisation noise 122/√12 ≈ 35 e⁻, which adds only 1.5% in quadrature to a 200 e⁻ analogue ENC; full-scale charge 1 V ÷ 50 mV/fC = 20 fC = 1.25×10⁵ e⁻ ≈ 5.2 MIPs, a dynamic range of 1.25×10⁵/200 ≈ 625; at 1 mW per channel, 10⁶ channels dissipate 1 kW. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：用注入脈衝量 ADC 線性度（INL/DNL）與增益一致性，確認通道間增益離散在 1–2% 內；以無訊號資料驗證數位基線追蹤與共模扣除後的雜訊回到單通道 ENC；量光纖鏈誤碼率、每通道功耗與溫升，並與冷卻設計比較。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Measure ADC linearity (INL/DNL) and gain uniformity with injected pulses and confirm channel-to-channel gain spread within 1–2%; use signal-free data to verify that noise after digital baseline tracking and common-mode subtraction returns to the single-channel ENC; measure optical-link bit-error rate, per-channel power and temperature rise and compare with the cooling design.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。

optionsEn: Longer shaping time always means lower noise.
Noise is set only by the preamplifier chip; layout and grounding affect only the digital side.
Gain 50 mV/fC, 10-bit ADC, 1 V full scale: LSB = 0.98 mV = 0.0195 fC ≈ 122 e⁻, quantisation noise 122/√12 ≈ 35 e⁻, which adds only 1.5% in quadrature to a 200 e⁻ analogue ENC.

steps.title: 整合：ASIC 讀出、數位化與動態範圍：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Integration: ASIC readout, digitisation and dynamic range: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「ADC、數位濾波與資料鏈」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “ADC, digital filtering and data links” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 用注入脈衝量 ADC 線性度（INL/DNL）與增益一致性，確認通道間增益離散在 1–2% 內；以無訊號資料驗證數位基線追蹤與共模扣除後的雜訊回到單通道 ENC；量光纖鏈誤碼率、每通道功耗與溫升，並與冷卻設計比較。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Measure ADC linearity (INL/DNL) and gain uniformity with injected pulses and confirm channel-to-channel gain spread within 1–2%; use signal-free data to verify that noise after digital baseline tracking and common-mode subtraction returns to the single-channel ENC; measure optical-link bit-error rate, per-channel power and temperature rise and compare with the cooling design. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：共模雜訊未扣除時整板通道一起上下擺動，單通道 ENC 看似合格，但叢集電荷總和的雜訊隨通道數線性而非平方根成長；ADC 位元數不足則低能端被量化台階撐寬。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: Without common-mode subtraction all channels on a board move together, each channel's ENC looks fine but the noise of summed cluster charge grows linearly rather than as the square root of channel count; too few ADC bits widen the low-energy end with quantisation steps.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 用注入脈衝量 ADC 線性度（INL/DNL）與增益一致性，確認通道間增益離散在 1–2% 內；以無訊號資料驗證數位基線追蹤與共模扣除後的雜訊回到單通道 ENC；量光纖鏈誤碼率、每通道功耗與溫升，並與冷卻設計比較。
knowledge.textEn: Measure ADC linearity (INL/DNL) and gain uniformity with injected pulses and confirm channel-to-channel gain spread within 1–2%; use signal-free data to verify that noise after digital baseline tracking and common-mode subtraction returns to the single-channel ENC; measure optical-link bit-error rate, per-channel power and temperature rise and compare with the cooling design.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「整合：ASIC 讀出、數位化與動態範圍」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Integration: ASIC readout, digitisation and dynamic range"?
options: 用注入脈衝量 ADC 線性度（INL/DNL）與增益一致性，確認通道間增益離散在 1–2% 內。
量測時不必記錄溫度、振動與時間等條件，因為它們不會影響結果。

optionsEn: Measure ADC linearity (INL/DNL) and gain uniformity with injected pulses and confirm channel-to-channel gain spread within 1–2%.

quiz.explanationEn: Measure ADC linearity (INL/DNL) and gain uniformity with injected pulses and confirm channel-to-channel gain spread within 1–2%; use signal-free data to verify that noise after digital baseline tracking and common-mode subtraction returns to the single-channel ENC; measure optical-link bit-error rate, per-channel power and temperature rise and compare with the cooling design. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: 整合：ASIC 讀出、數位化與動態範圍：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Integration: ASIC readout, digitisation and dynamic range: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「ADC、數位濾波與資料鏈」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。

Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.

steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。

knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測確認；只更換零件或放寬參數可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

steps.title: 系統驗證、門檻設定與工程交接：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: System validation, threshold setting and engineering handoff: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「門檻佔用率與驗收報告」如何決定低雜訊偵測器讀出的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Threshold occupancy and acceptance record” determines the key performance of “Low-noise detector readout”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 系統層級的驗證是在完整安裝、接地與冷卻條件下重做雜訊量測，因為 ENC 在實驗室與實驗大廳常差一倍；接著用雜訊佔用率決定門檻：高斯雜訊超過門檻 k·ENC 的機率為 ½·erfc(k/√2)，乘上取樣率與通道數就是假訊號率，必須與效率要求折衷。交接文件必須含每通道的增益、ENC、門檻與遮蔽清單、溫度係數、注入電容常數與長期穩定度紀錄，讓後續校正可以追溯。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「門檻佔用率與驗收報告」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: System-level validation repeats the noise measurements with the full installation, grounding and cooling in place, because ENC in the lab and in the experimental hall often differ by a factor of two; the threshold is then set from noise occupancy: the probability that Gaussian noise exceeds a threshold k·ENC is ½·erfc(k/√2), and multiplied by sampling rate and channel count it gives the fake-hit rate, which must be traded against efficiency. The handoff record must include per-channel gain, ENC, threshold and masking list, temperature coefficients, injection-capacitor constants and long-term stability logs so that later calibrations remain traceable. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Threshold occupancy and acceptance record”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：取 ENC = 800 e⁻（含安裝後的雜散電容與干擾）、門檻 4000 e⁻ = 5σ：單次取樣的雜訊超越機率 ½·erfc(5/√2) ≈ 2.9×10⁻⁷；40 MHz 取樣下每通道 11.5 Hz，10⁶ 個通道合計 1.15×10⁷ Hz 的假訊號；門檻提高到 6σ = 4800 e⁻ 時機率 ≈ 9.9×10⁻¹⁰，每通道 0.04 Hz，而 24,000 e⁻ 的 MIP 訊號仍有 5 倍餘裕。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Take ENC = 800 e⁻ (including post-installation stray capacitance and interference) and a threshold of 4000 e⁻ = 5σ: the per-sample noise crossing probability is ½·erfc(5/√2) ≈ 2.9×10⁻⁷; at 40 MHz sampling that is 11.5 Hz per channel and 1.15×10⁷ Hz of fake hits over 10⁶ channels; raising the threshold to 6σ = 4800 e⁻ gives ≈ 9.9×10⁻¹⁰, 0.04 Hz per channel, while a 24,000 e⁻ MIP signal still has a margin of 5.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「每個通道在實驗室測過雜訊，安裝後就不必再量。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Once every channel's noise is measured in the lab, no remeasurement is needed after installation." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「門檻佔用率與驗收報告」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Threshold occupancy and acceptance record”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

steps.title: 系統驗證、門檻設定與工程交接：定量估算
steps.titleEn: System validation, threshold setting and engineering handoff: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「門檻佔用率與驗收報告」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Threshold occupancy and acceptance record” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：取 ENC = 800 e⁻（含安裝後的雜散電容與干擾）、門檻 4000 e⁻ = 5σ：單次取樣的雜訊超越機率 ½·erfc(5/√2) ≈ 2.9×10⁻⁷；40 MHz 取樣下每通道 11.5 Hz，10⁶ 個通道合計 1.15×10⁷ Hz 的假訊號；門檻提高到 6σ = 4800 e⁻ 時機率 ≈ 9.9×10⁻¹⁰，每通道 0.04 Hz，而 24,000 e⁻ 的 MIP 訊號仍有 5 倍餘裕。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Take ENC = 800 e⁻ (including post-installation stray capacitance and interference) and a threshold of 4000 e⁻ = 5σ: the per-sample noise crossing probability is ½·erfc(5/√2) ≈ 2.9×10⁻⁷; at 40 MHz sampling that is 11.5 Hz per channel and 1.15×10⁷ Hz of fake hits over 10⁶ channels; raising the threshold to 6σ = 4800 e⁻ gives ≈ 9.9×10⁻¹⁰, 0.04 Hz per channel, while a 24,000 e⁻ MIP signal still has a margin of 5. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：逐通道做門檻掃描（S 曲線）得到雜訊佔用率對門檻的關係，擬合出 ENC 與門檻偏移並與注入校正的 ENC 比較；用宇宙射線或放射源量不同門檻下的效率，選出效率 ≥ 99% 且佔用率達標的工作點；把全部參數寫入校正資料庫並做一次冷啟動重載驗證。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Run threshold scans (S-curves) channel by channel to obtain noise occupancy versus threshold, fit for ENC and threshold offset and compare with the injection-calibrated ENC; measure efficiency at several thresholds with cosmic rays or a source and choose the working point with at least 99% efficiency at the target occupancy; write all parameters into the calibration database and validate with a cold-start reload.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

steps.title: 系統驗證、門檻設定與工程交接：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: System validation, threshold setting and engineering handoff: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「門檻佔用率與驗收報告」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Threshold occupancy and acceptance record” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 逐通道做門檻掃描（S 曲線）得到雜訊佔用率對門檻的關係，擬合出 ENC 與門檻偏移並與注入校正的 ENC 比較；用宇宙射線或放射源量不同門檻下的效率，選出效率 ≥ 99% 且佔用率達標的工作點；把全部參數寫入校正資料庫並做一次冷啟動重載驗證。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Run threshold scans (S-curves) channel by channel to obtain noise occupancy versus threshold, fit for ENC and threshold offset and compare with the injection-calibrated ENC; measure efficiency at several thresholds with cosmic rays or a source and choose the working point with at least 99% efficiency at the target occupancy; write all parameters into the calibration database and validate with a cold-start reload. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：門檻在實驗室條件下設定、安裝後 ENC 升高一倍卻未重新掃描時，佔用率從 10⁻⁷ 暴增到 10⁻³，資料鏈飽和、觸發率失控；反之為了壓佔用率把門檻設太高，低電荷的邊緣叢集被丟棄，位置解析度變差。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: If thresholds set in the lab are kept after installation doubles the ENC, occupancy jumps from 10⁻⁷ to 10⁻³, the data links saturate and trigger rates run away; setting thresholds too high to suppress occupancy instead discards low-charge edge clusters and degrades position resolution.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.text: 逐通道做門檻掃描（S 曲線）得到雜訊佔用率對門檻的關係，擬合出 ENC 與門檻偏移並與注入校正的 ENC 比較；用宇宙射線或放射源量不同門檻下的效率，選出效率 ≥ 99% 且佔用率達標的工作點；把全部參數寫入校正資料庫並做一次冷啟動重載驗證。
knowledge.textEn: Run threshold scans (S-curves) channel by channel to obtain noise occupancy versus threshold, fit for ENC and threshold offset and compare with the injection-calibrated ENC; measure efficiency at several thresholds with cosmic rays or a source and choose the working point with at least 99% efficiency at the target occupancy; write all parameters into the calibration database and validate with a cold-start reload.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

steps.instruction: 門檻在實驗室條件下設定、安裝後 ENC 升高一倍卻未重新掃描時，佔用率從 10⁻⁷ 暴增到 10⁻³，資料鏈飽和、觸發率失控；反之為了壓佔用率把門檻設太高，低電荷的邊緣叢集被丟棄，位置解析度變差。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: If thresholds set in the lab are kept after installation doubles the ENC, occupancy jumps from 10⁻⁷ to 10⁻³, the data links saturate and trigger rates run away; setting thresholds too high to suppress occupancy instead discards low-charge edge clusters and degrades position resolution. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：交接文件必須含每通道的增益、ENC、門檻與遮蔽清單、溫度係數、注入電容常數與長期穩定度紀錄，讓後續校正可以追溯。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The handoff record must include per-channel gain, ENC, threshold and masking list, temperature coefficients, injection-capacitor constants and long-term stability logs so that later calibrations remain traceable.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「每個通道在實驗室測過雜訊，安裝後就不必再量。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Once every channel's noise is measured in the lab, no remeasurement is needed after installation." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測確認；只更換零件或放寬參數可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.
